name: Ajani Unrelenting
description: An Echoverse leonin whose battle cry strikes fear, dedicated to vengeance after his brother's death and lashing out at anyone in the Theorist's way.

description_citations.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Ajani's brother Jazal is killed during the Conflux Wars while trying to broker peace.
timeline.quote: Ajani's brother, Jazal, was a kind and just leader struck down during Alara's Conflux Wars while trying to broker peace.

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Ajani carves a trail of carnage across the Echoverse seeking revenge for his brother.
timeline.quote: He carved a trail of carnage across the Echoverse as he sought revenge against those he judged responsible for his brother's death.

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.
